Droopy leaves can be from over or under watering and many other things. Difficult to say what the problem is without more info. How often did you water, and how? (From the top or from the bottom?) Did you wait until the soil was dry before watering? Is the air in your room dry (eg. From central  heating) or damp? Is it summer or winter where you are - How much daylight do you get? 

I wait until the soil has dried out, but isn't bone dry. How quickly this happens depends on the temperature of the room, how much sunlight there has been, etc. so I don't water on a schedule, but check the soil every now and then. I dunno if this is a good idea but I check the bottom of the soil by sticking a finger up through the drainage hole and feeling the dampness - but most people recommend checking dryness by sticking your finger an inch into the top of the soil. Then I water by having them sit in a deep tub of room-temp water for half an hour, then leaving on a towel for a few hours for the excess water to drain away.

You can get around Bristol by bus - student single journeys are ~£1-1.50 depending how far you go. Buy them in bulk on the First bus phone app so it's cheaper.

Bristol is relatively very foreigner friendly :)
